exceptions.reason: The part writes no `data-pressed` and no `data-disabled`. CSS selects the states on the same element: `[aria-pressed='true']`, `:disabled`, and `[aria-disabled='true']` on an element that is not a native button (rule 8.15). The family has no namespace of constants (rule 8.10).

`Toggle.test.ts` tests the element and the attributes of the developer, `as` and the `element` slot, the pressed state with `v-model`, the events and `details.cancel()`, the disabled states and the fieldset. The cancel of a toggle in a group is in `ToggleGroup.test.ts`. The part reads its element, so the cases of `nativeButton` render a `<span>` in `as` or in the `element` slot. A `type` and a `form` of the developer reach the element and win, as each attribute of the developer does (rules 6.3 and 8.2). Base UI takes the two out. A developer who writes `type="submit"` asks for it.
The prop only says what the developer renders (rule 8.3). The part reads the element that it renders, and `as` or the `element` slot renders another element.

The part writes no `data-pressed` and no `data-disabled`: `[aria-pressed='true']`, `:disabled` and `[aria-disabled='true']` select the states on the same element (rule 8.15). The family has no namespace of constants (rule 8.10).
